title: Left/Right always switches tabs even while a custom-model or notify text input …
body: Left/Right always switches tabs even while a custom-model or notify text input is focused (per AC5 and covered by a test), so arrow keys cannot move the text cursor within those fields. This is intended by the spec; consider suppressing TabBar navigation while a TextInput is active in a future iteration for smoother editing.

title: rewriteFrontmatterEffort insert path interpolates frontmatterBody into the repl…
body: rewriteFrontmatterEffort insert path interpolates frontmatterBody into the replacement string passed to String.replace; a body containing $-sequences ($&, $1) would be reinterpreted. Agent frontmatter is controlled content so the risk is nil, but a replacer function would be more robust.
